retrievalProfile.description: A dark, textured leather background featuring deep-etched floral filigree and highly ornate, interlocking gold-outlined custom lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition centered on a complex, interlocking typographic mark with a gold-foil finish, set against a dark chocolate brown leather surface deeply embossed with swirling acanthus-style filigree and framed by a multi-layered decorative border.
coreVisualRelationships: The central lettering is the primary focal point, occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame.
The background filigree provides a dense, low-contrast texture that recedes behind the bright gold outlines.
A secondary horizontal plaque at the bottom anchors the composition and provides a clear area for subtitle text.
The outer border echoes the gold and embossed motifs, containing the busy interior elements.
coreInvariants: Dark brown leather texture with visible grain
Gold or bronze metallic outlines on all text elements
Symmetrical corner ornaments in the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main title is centrally stacked and oversized, while the subtitle is contained in a small rectangular plaque at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bottom horizontal plaque acts as a visual weight that stabilizes the vertical energy of the interlocking letters.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left of the large lettering, follows the interlocking curves downward, and rests on the legible subtitle plaque.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the entire surface is filled with either text or dense embossed patterns.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the metallic gold lines and the dark matte leather.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are vertically elongated with varying widths
Extensive use of interlocking swashes and ligatures
Double-stroke outlines with a darker fill in the center
Sharp, spurred serifs and teardrop terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders transform into decorative scrolls that wrap around neighboring letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly complex, custom-drawn display mark paired with a legible, spaced-out serif for information clarity.

preserve: Interlocking nature of the main text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base Western spur-serif skeleton for modification.
Captures the scrollwork and decorative flourishes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark brown leather texture with deep debossed Victorian floral filigree and a gold-lined rectangular border with ornate corners. Include a small horizontal gold plaque at the bottom center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom interlocking lettering in the center with gold metallic outlines and a dark burgundy fill. Add a simple serif title inside the bottom plaque using an engraved effect.

verificationChecks: Is the leather texture tactile and grainy?
Do the letters interlock without losing legibility?
Is the gold finish burnished rather than bright yellow?
Is the filigree background subtle enough to not distract from the text?

mustRedesign: Unique owl icons in the plaque
postGenerationChecks: Check for depth in the debossing
Ensure the gold outlines have a consistent bevel
Verify the plaque text is centered
Confirm the border corners are symmetrical
recipe.reuseFormula: Tooled Leather + Interlocking Gold Lettering + Victorian Filigree + Dark Earth Tones
